title: Wilderness and Wine Tasting out of Anchorage
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Must be 21 with ID for winery.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a captivating journey along the Turnagain Arm scenic drive, where opportunities to spot Dall sheep and Beluga whales abound. Capture stunning photographs as you immerse yourself in the beauty of Alaska's landscape. Visit the Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center to encounter and learn about remarkable Alaskan wildlife. Continue to Portage Glacier Lake for additional scenic views and potential surprise stops for lunch. Conclude your adventure with a delightful wine tasting experience back in Anchorage before returning to your hotel. 

- Scenic drive featuring potential wildlife sightings along Turnagain Arm
- Visit the Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center for a close encounter with local wildlife
- Photo opportunities at Portage Glacier Lake and surprise stops along the route
- Tour duration is approximately 5-6 hours, with longer options for wildlife sightings
